tool.name: Focaloop Stage-0 31-mer bait scanner
tool.description: screen the first bytes of many runs for a query locus
tool.command: focaloop bait --query-fasta '$query' --inputs #for $r in $reads '$r' #end for --run-ids #for $r in $reads '$r.element_identifier' #end for --probe-bytes \$(( $probe_kb * 1024 )) --min-hit-reads $min_hit_reads --state-dir bait_state --out-tsv '$bait_hits'

param.name: probe_kb
param.label: Probe size per run (KiB of compressed input)

param.name: min_hit_reads
param.label: Minimum hit reads for a run to pass

tool.help:
**What it does**
Stage-0 pan-repository screen. Reads the first *probe size* KiB of every input, counts reads sharing at least two canonical 31-mers with the query, and reports the hit rate with a Wilson 95% lower bound. Runs that pass are worth a full focal loop; the rest are dropped after a few hundred KiB.
-----
**Output**
One row per run: `run_id`, `stream_tier`, `probe_bytes`, `probe_reads`, `hit_reads`, `hit_rate`, `wilson_ci95_low`, `pass_gate` (passing runs first). For SRA/ENA accessions streamed over HTTPS range requests, use the user-defined tool variant.
